name: Widget Desktop
description: Surface canvas manager for interactive widgets, telemetry gauges, and collaborative whiteboards.
capabilities: Owner's widgets on the display: resources, systems, firewall, updates and news when you come close

settings.NUXIVA_SECRETARY: On the display, show the owner's widgets when they come close
settings.NUXIVA_DISPLAY_PRESENCE_GATE: On the display, show buttons, widgets and chat only when an authorized person is seen or heard
settings.NUXIVA_DISPLAY_GUEST_PUBLIC: With guests only, also show public widgets suitable for guests
settings.NUXIVA_DISPLAY_TRUST_GUESTS: With guests present, also show household widgets
settings.NUXIVA_DISPLAY_LEARNING: The display learns the habits of each authorized person (encrypted data, never with guests)
settings.NUXIVA_DISPLAY_ROOM_STRICT: On screens in rooms without a camera, show only what is fine for anyone
